C-STABILIZE-TRAIN-MIRROR.ApprovalBasis: Owner-approved RECOVERY and delegated coordinator decision on 2026-11-10. Repair truthful pending acceptance projection before the separate closeout/admission PR. No source edits to frozen integration or QA snapshot, no external Project calls, no API/apply changes, field-option changes, admission, version or publication authority.

Keep explicit accepted and complete legacy owner acceptance outputs unchanged; operational/notPresent stay not-required.
Clear an old accepted value with the existing reconciliation path and prove idempotence, without changing API/apply behavior or governance options.

Constraints.Constraint: Only tools/release-project-sync.mjs, its existing focused tests, M046/V046 current projections/index notes and this child bundle may change. Preserve original approved bundles.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No admission/acceptance creation, schema-option expansion or existing-draft-body mutation API.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Meaningful red tests reproduce pending/negative projections as accepted before the fix; accepted controls stay green.
Pending create omits the owner select field and never writes accepted; old accepted clears, rerun converges, no unowned field changes or deletions occur.
Relevant Project-sync/readiness/train tests, current/final GRACE gates and exact input preservation pass; export only new scoped deltas for coordinator import.
